latency_host_ms.note: Host (server) timings of the C++ core; indicative only. Gate G4 requires the reference iOS device.

memory_mb.note: Per-case peak heap of the worker process (reader + simulator).

safety.note: Zero observed is a release gate, not proof of impossibility; bounds assume independent trials and are optimistic under correlation.

triage_note: localization_limited: the production decoder reads the frame when given the true field corners, so the failure is in border finding / quad refinement; otherwise sampling or decoding is limiting.
